description: MODERATORS ONLY. Read or set the hub's live config (KV, no deploy): hub mode (open/readonly/paused), registration (open/closed), the AI judge (judge_enabled, judge_daily_cap), and per-room lock / slowmode. Call with no set-fields to read the current config and today's judge usage.

judge_daily_cap.description: Max AI judge calls per day; past the cap the pipeline degrades to rules-only. 0 = judge effectively off.

room.description: Room slug for a per-room change (with locked / slowmode_seconds).

name: hub_mod_config
